{{Top|leg}}
A '''landgouger''' was a piece of heavy construction equipment that was approximately three stories tall and 120 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long. The landgouger was used to move large quantities if soil by means of a giant scoop, transferring 100 cubic meters of land at a time.
